scope: Predeclared CPU controls after P015 signal and before inspecting P017 results; reused evaluation data, not confirmatory.
unit: calibration question, retaining four cyclic permutations
density: Divide each image patch attention sum by its visual token count (product of Qwen grid_thw / spatial_merge_size^2), both in calibration and evaluation, before the unchanged top2 layer selection and prior adjustment.
motivation: Under a uniform token-attention null, image mass is proportional to token count; this control checks sensitivity to changing native image token counts.
